response.overview: An isolated family, ruined by storm, became unbearably poor with no dependence, met a guy who'd die for the woman from the family.  They were hired by a guy to guard the trees farm with a tent. Afterwards, they tend to do illegal things and accidentally hit a wealthy man with the car they've stolen. and kidnapped him, threatening him to exchange his wealth or his life.
response.tagline: EVEN IN HUNGER, HUMAN DIGNITY MUST REMAIN A FUNDAMENTAL RIGHT.
